scope: HBQ crew-left-behind intent and CBE passenger/crew boundary
sourceIntent: Remember operating seat role/turret path, exclude cargo and FFV.
Preserve unassignment and incapacitation; native assigned-seat re-entry after delay.
Later forced seating and group detachment are source shortcuts, not adopted by CBE.
currentCallPaths: DrivingOperationStep -> DrivingCrewStep: internal dead-driver seat replacement only.
CortexRestoreCalm / CortexGroupTick -> CortexPassengerReady: cargo-only finite remount.
CortexLocality resumes public passenger remount original deadline; it does not retain operating role/turret path.
finding: Passenger remount cannot stand in for operating-crew return: assignAsCargo would discard operating-role intent. No complete ordinary dismounted-crew return executor exists.
implementedThisBatch: Shared passenger admission now refuses boarding over explicit STOP or disabled MOVE/PATH, and refuses hidden/suspended actor/platform routine transitions.
DrivingCrewBoarding cooperates with current native GET IN for exact assigned empty operating seats through the existing sole driving cap writer.
Per-seat original 60-second public limits survive owner change on the same route; expired attempts cannot renew until boarding or assignment/context change.
New actor tasks end cooperation; active reverse/pass/bypass/corridor work prevents admission. Fresh plain route/crew intent is checked at the cap commit.
No recall order, assignment mutation, boarding permission override, forced seating or independent speed writer.
nextFoundation: Capture actual occupied operating-seat provenance within existing driving operation, excluding cargo and FFV.
Observe still-assigned dismounted crew with original finite deadlines; preserve explicit unassignment and newer actor tasks.
Keep role/turret identity and issue at most one native re-entry attempt through current actor owner; do not reuse cargo remount.
Vehicle cooperation must use existing sole speed writer with exact finite receipt; no separate movement loop.
Owner migration must preserve original deadline and issued-state provenance without replay.

validation.failedFocusedCheck: An explanatory comment matched a forbidden-command assertion; executable-body check corrected. Full existing suite then passed.

authorityLimit: orderGetIn false preserves assignedVehicle. Assignment alone is not recall permission. The implementation supports an observed GET IN without re-enabling boarding. Same-value native command changes wholly between observations remain unobservable.
remaining: Automatic recall of dismounted operating crew is not implemented.
Absent driver return and cross-group boarding are not implemented.
Physical re-entry, blocked boarding, repeated departures, split ownership and measured runtime cost remain unverified.

boardingProgressFollowup.implementation: Original public per-seat receipt now carries ASL motion anchor and last measured progress time. Two metres of actual actor motion updates only progress metadata; twelve seconds without motion ends cooperation without any boarding cancellation. Original sixty-second deadline never renews.
boardingProgressFollowup.schema: Seven-field rows are required; unknown/old shapes refuse without native commands.
boardingProgressFollowup.cost: At most20 actor position observations per helper sample; active waits recheck at existing cap commit. Public progress updates only when the anchor changes by two metres. No new rays, world scan, worker or handler.
boardingProgressFollowup.limits: Detour/stair motion is progress, not boarding proof. Motion wholly between observations is not reconstructed; fixed expiry remains authoritative. Actual path-planning latency and boarding timing unverified.

nativePlanningFollowup20261020.sourceIntent: Preserve an operating crew role and let native return finish before moving on. Source forced seating and group detachment are not adopted. Retained assignment alone cannot override mission boarding permission.
nativePlanningFollowup20261020.implementation: Existing GET IN cooperation now defers the twelve-second no-motion exhaustion only for native INIT/PLANNING/REPLAN. Search can consume only the original60-second seat deadline and never updates motion anchors or progress time. BUSY/WAIT/INITFAILED/DELAY/STOPPED do not receive this allowance. Queue root QUEUE_CROSSED_HOLD is classified TRAFFIC to retain existing one-second callback cadence.
nativePlanningFollowup20261020.authority: Still requires local eligible actor, actual native GET IN, current exact assigned empty operating seat and live plain-route/crew admission. No assignment, orderGetIn, forced seating, group transfer or new worker.
nativePlanningFollowup20261020.cost: Native planner query only for stalled eligible seat rows, at most20 rows per helper call. Existing cap commit rechecks waiting admission. No world/ray query or new timer. Engine cost unmeasured.
nativePlanningFollowup20261020.remaining: Automatic operating-crew recall, absent-driver return and cross-group pickup remain incomplete; physical re-entry, delayed planning, repeated departures, interruption and normal/HC cost remain unverified.

unloadBoardingAcquisition20261020.finding: First ordinary/convoy unload-policy acquisition called setUnloadInCombat without checking assigned incoming native GET IN. Official engine documentation describes forced orderGetIn false as a command side effect. Actual in-engine interruption has not been reproduced while audits are paused.
unloadBoardingAcquisition20261020.implementation: Before first lease acquisition only, observe fullCrew including assignments; process <=64 rows. Defer with no lease/roster publication if a living actor assigned to this vehicle is outside it and has native GET IN, or is not local so intent is unverifiable. Oversized snapshot also refuses. Already-owned adoption remains write-free; newer-policy blocking, epochs/revisions, exact previous/applied restoration and takeover policy unchanged. Guard exits outer function before success/tracked publication.
unloadBoardingAcquisition20261020.cost: One fullCrew engine observation at first acquisition attempts only, <=64 returned rows processed. No new world scan/timer/handler/native boarding command. Rejected acquisition can retry at existing caller cadence; no new cadence. Runtime cost unmeasured.
unloadBoardingAcquisition20261020.limits: Protects existing boarding; does not authorize orderGetIn true from retained assignment alone, force seating, recall absent drivers or establish HBQ crew-return parity. orderGetIn false may preserve assignment; that intent remains respected. Existing release restoration remains a separate native-side-effect review boundary.

unloadNoopWrites20261020.finding: Initial acquire and exact release could call setUnloadInCombat with an already-current value. This needlessly repeats documented engine boarding side effects even when previous==applied.
unloadNoopWrites20261020.implementation: Both ordinary/convoy acquisition and restoration skip the engine command when previous==applied. Initial boarding preflight runs only when a policy change is needed; already-matching policy can record its ordinary exact lease without interrupting boarding. Leases/current-value proof, external-change blocking, restoration permission and newer controller protection remain.
unloadNoopWrites20261020.cost: One existing policy read qualifies first-acquisition seat scan; matching baseline avoids that scan and native write. No new worker/state/timer. Frame and network effect unmeasured.
unloadNoopWrites20261020.limits: Restoration to a different previous value can still have native side effects; no deferred restoration lifetime or stale replay is introduced. Existing actual native boarding, repeated use, locality/HC and performance unverified.

convoySeatIntent20261020.sourceIntent: HBQ crew return treats changed/unassigned vehicle intent as ordered-out rather than automatic return consent. CBE explicit convoy upkeep adopts actual occupants, but cannot continually reclaim newer assigned seats/vehicles on the same convoy revision.
convoySeatIntent20261020.finding: Mounted-upkeep repairSeat treated assignment changes as faults on every sample, and only driver/effective-commander native tasks were checked at entry. A gunner/passenger assignment or service task could be overwritten by assignAs/orderGetIn upkeep.
convoySeatIntent20261020.implementation: Read previous actual-adoption marker before per-unit admission. Same group/revision plus changed vehicle or occupied-seat assignment vetoes repair and boarding, independent of recorded clientOwner; a fresh explicit revision can adopt. Shared existing task list and actor movement-reservation veto apply to each occupant before native seat writes. Existing driver/operator whole-callback guard remains. No forced seats/new worker/timer/settings.
convoySeatIntent20261020.cost: Reuses existing per-occupant assignment reads; adds marker comparison and per-actor native task/reservation predicate. No extra world/seat scan or publication. Engine cost unmeasured.
convoySeatIntent20261020.limits: Physical assignment transitions, service tasks, owner migration, renewed explicit revisions and actual boarding unverified. Identical native writes remain indistinguishable. This does not implement automatic crew recall or prove source parity.

differentValueRestorationReview20261020.finding: Ordinary master stop/group release and convoy release restore exact previous/applied lease without an existing dedicated deferred unload-property service. Native setUnloadInCombat side effect on different-value restoration has not been reproduced.
differentValueRestorationReview20261020.disposition: Retain exact existing restoration for now. Do not discard a changed policy without restoring it, blindly reissue incoming orderGetIn true, or add an unbounded/new cleanup worker based on the documentation alone. Preserve as explicit engine acceptance boundary, distinct from completed no-op/initial-admission protections.
